WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8
), store_sales_returns AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk, 
           CASE WHEN ((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "30 days",
           CASE WHEN (((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) > 30) AND ((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) <= 60)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "31-60 days",
           CASE WHEN (((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) > 60) AND ((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) <= 90)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "61-90 days",
           CASE WHEN (((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) > 90) AND ((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) <= 120)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "91-120 days",
           CASE WHEN ((d2.d_date_sk - d1.d_date_sk) > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ">120 days"
    FROM store_sales ss JOIN store_returns sr ON (ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk)
        JOIN filtered_date_dim d1 ON (d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk) 
        JOIN filtered_date_dim d2 ON (d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk)
    WHERE ss.ss_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk 
), store_sales_returns_joined AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_sales_returns JOIN store ON (store_sales_returns.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk)
)
SELECT store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, store.s_street_name, 
       store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, store.s_county, store.s_state, 
       store.s_zip, "30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91-120 days", ">120 days"
FROM store_sales_returns_joined JOIN store ON (store.s_store_sk = store_sales_returns_joined.ss_store_sk)
GROUP BY store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, store.s_street_name, 
         store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, store.s_county, store.s_state, 
         store.s_zip, "30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91-120 days", ">120 days"
ORDER BY store.s_store_name, store.s_company_id, store.s_street_number, 
         store.s_street_name, store.s_street_type, store.s_suite_number, store.s_city, 
         store.s_county, store.s_state, store.s_zip LIMIT 100
